name: alert_emergency_contact
description: Phone the patient's registered emergency contact through Amazon Connect (Polly TTS in Urdu/Hindi/English). ESI 1-2 only, once per case. Without contact_phone it returns SKIPPED_NO_CONTACT.

esi_level.description: Structured triage ESI level (1-5). Only 1 and 2 call.

contact_phone.description: Emergency contact phone, E.164. Omit if none is registered.

emergency_details.description: One plain-language sentence for the family member.

name: match_specialist_doctor
description: Rank the free on-duty doctors to offer the case to (a doctor already holding a case or an offer is skipped): the required specialty first, then General Emergency, then any active doctor. Assigns nobody: the first doctor to accept the offer takes the case. Returns OFFER_PENDING with candidates, or NO_DOCTOR_AVAILABLE. Once per case when case_id is given.

required_specialty.description: Cardiology, Neurology, Trauma, Pulmonology or General Emergency.

clinical_summary.description: Short clinical summary for the doctor.

case_id.description: ResQ case ID (makes the ranking idempotent).

name: generate_video_session
description: Create (or reuse) the Amazon Chime SDK video room for a case and return the patient and doctor join links.

doctor_name.description: Name of the doctor joining the call.
